d:
Hellooooooooo Everyoooooooone!!

Winds of Change is a long story about a man, named Will, who gets a flashlight device that can change someones gender! Throughout the story he learns more about himself and those around him as he experiments with his gender identity! But under the surface, something more nefarious is going on with the device! Through this journey can Will find happiness? Or is this device and the baggage attached, ultimately going to be his downfall?? I hope you enjoy this story!!

Also, I just wanted to mention this is a sequel, directly from MY TOY. But also a sequel to A Gray Day, and How My Daughter Turned Me Into Her Mama. You can still read this without reading those other comics, but reading them definitely helps with knowing some of the characters a bit more!

UPDATE 8/28/26: Over on Patreon, I just wrapped up Volume 1 of this Story! I have started on a completely brand new story over there called Feral Soul!
ALSO: In case you haven't noticed, things in this story are starting to get darker. I know that's not everyone's cup of tea, so, if you don't like dark themes you should not get invested in this story/ my work in general.

If you enjoy this story, please consider supporting me!
